blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Corporate & Investment Banking. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

CIB margins compress while deal complexity grows: origination research, credit memos, trade documentation and risk reporting all consume expensive analyst hours that agentic systems can compress — with the control discipline investment banks cannot compromise.

items: Pitch books, credit memos and research notes re-type data from terminals and filings; quality varies by analyst stamina.
LCs, trade documents and settlement instructions fail on reference mismatches; exception queues run through time zones.

Governance inherits the sector frame — Basel capital regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Answers with citations, not vibes: permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.
Models that read scans, scenes and schematics: multimodal intelligence wired into operations.
Financials, covenants and policy assembled with citations into draft memos (memo cycle time down 50-60%)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Banking & Financial Services level this capability reads as: analysts draft credit memos with retrieval over mandates, financials and policy, every paragraph citing its source (memo preparation time down 50-60%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
